name: PZL TS-11 Iskra
variants: TS-11 Iskra bis A / B / D
summary: Polish tandem jet trainer with a straight wing, wing-root intakes and a single turbojet, flown by the Polish Air Force and the Biało-Czerwone Iskry team; a score are registered in the US.

wings: Low-mid, straight wing with rounded tips
engines: Single turbojet with air intakes at the wing roots on each side of the fuselage
Single round tailpipe at the rear
fuselage: Slim, sleek fuselage with a long single bubble canopy over tandem seats
tail: Swept fin with a gentle taper
Horizontal tail mounted on the fuselage

tellTales: Slim straight-winged jet with wing-root intakes and a long tandem canopy
Smooth, narrow fuselage and a pointed nose
Often in white-and-red Polish colors with tip tanks

confusedWith.howToTell: The L-29 has a pot-bellied fuselage, two separate canopies and fuselage-side intakes; the Iskra is slimmer with a long single canopy and wing-root intakes.
The Magister has a V-tail and two engines; the Iskra has a conventional tail and a single engine.
The T-33 has large tip tanks and a long, slim nose with fuselage intakes; the Iskra has wing-root intakes and a shorter fuselage.
The L-39 has a tapered wing, a short nose and side intakes; the Iskra has a straight wing and wing-root intakes.
